Introduction

Lee Jun Young, also known mononymously as Jun, is a South Korean singer, rapper, dancer, and actor under BILLIONS and Jflex, the latter being a company he co-founded. He first rose to fame as a member of the boy group U-KISS and later gained recognition as part of the project group UNB, which was formed through the survival show The Unit. Beyond his idol activities, he has also taken on acting roles, portraying Kwon Ryuk in the fictional idol group SHAX and Taein in the project group LUNA.

Jun launched his solo career on December 5, 2019 with the single album Gallery. His participation in The Unit in 2017 brought him wide attention, as he emerged as the top-ranked male contestant and went on to debut in UNB. The group was active until its disbandment in 2019. After several years focused on acting and other projects, Jun prepared for his musical return in 2025. On July 21, reports surfaced that he would be releasing a new solo album in September, marking his first comeback in nearly five years. The news was quickly confirmed by his agency, and on September 4, a promotion schedule was released for his first mini album, Last Dance, which is set to be unveiled on September 22.

In his personal life, Jun experienced the loss of his paternal grandmother on January 25, 2023. His company, Jflex, announced the news and confirmed that he would be canceling all scheduled activities to mourn with his family.
